en_lines: You cannot help but pause, for swords and spears clash in battle.
Through the passing hours, swords and spears clash in battle while you wander through all around.
I cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while the traveler listen to all around.
As the traveler drift along the path ahead, melancholy fills my breast.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for a lone crane soars.
They cannot help but pause, for the winding river.
Through the passing hours, distant peaks stand tall while the wanderer behold all around.

The poet linger by we raise our cups in farewell.
They cannot help but pause, for time slips away like running water.
